# Vue 3 Composition API coding guide

Curated by Skill Harbor — Anthony Fu's Vue 3 skill (the creator of VueUse and a Vue core contributor): an opinionated agent guide to modern Vue 3.5, always Composition API with `<script setup lang="ts">`. Covers script-setup macros (defineProps, defineEmits, defineModel, defineExpose), the reactivity system (ref, shallowRef, computed, watch, watchEffect, effectScope, lifecycle hooks), and built-in components and directives (Transition, Teleport, Suspense, KeepAlive, v-memo, custom directives), with a copy-paste component template and key imports. Clear taste rules included: prefer TypeScript, prefer shallowRef when deep reactivity is not needed, always Composition over Options API, discourage reactive props destructure. Honest caveat: generated from the Vue.js docs at 2026-09-25 — verify macro and API details against the current Vue docs if your target version differs. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
